ciu.title: The 7 key cities of Al-Andalus
ciu.sub: Each stop tells a different chapter of the eight centuries of Al-Andalus. We help you choose based on your time, your interests and your group.
ciu.cordoba: Capital of the Caliphate. The Mosque-Cathedral, Medina Azahara and the Jewish quarter. The heart of Al-Andalus.
ciu.sevilla: The Giralda, the Royal Alcázar, Triana. An Almohad capital that became the city of the great explorers.
ciu.granada: The Alhambra, the Albaicín, the Sacromonte. The last Nasrid kingdom, jewel between Sierra Nevada and the Mediterranean.
ciu.ronda: Perched above a 100-metre gorge. White villages, perfectly preserved Arab baths and an old town where time stands still.
ciu.malaga: Alcazaba and Gibralfaro overlooking the sea. Birthplace of Picasso, Mediterranean cultural capital and gateway to Andalusia.
ciu.toledo: The city of three cultures. Synagogues, mosques and cathedrals coexisting in a UNESCO old town above the Tagus.
ciu.madrid: Founded by Muslims as Mayrit. Today a cosmopolitan capital and ideal starting point to discover Al-Andalus.
ciu.alpujarra: The southern flank of Sierra Nevada. Pampaneira, Bubión and Capileira: the Morisco villages that kept Nasrid architecture alive after 1492. Tinaos, weaving looms and Arab irrigation channels.

pro.title: How it works
pro.sub: From first idea to final trip, with nothing for you to coordinate. All you do is enjoy it.
pro.s1p: Mark your cities on the map above and set your nights, hotel and level. In 2 minutes you'll have your route sketched out, no strings attached.
pro.s2p: Within 24-48h you'll receive a tailor-made proposal: day-by-day route, hotels, guides and a fixed price. No surprises, no fine print.
pro.s3p: We fine-tune it together over WhatsApp or email, down to the last detail. You pay nothing until the route is exactly the one you want.
pro.s4p: We coordinate the hotels, guides and transfers; all you do is travel. One single point of contact and 24/7 assistance throughout the tour.
hal.title: Designed by and for Muslim travelers
hal.p1: We know travelling as a Muslim is no small thing: finding quality halal food, keeping up with prayers, navigating Ramadan on the road. We know because we live it.
hal.p2: Every halal group gets verified restaurants in each city, prayer stops built into the itinerary, a calendar adapted to the lunar month, and culturally attuned guides.
hal.certp: Verified restaurants, prayer times respected, calendar adapted.

b2b.title: Are you an agency, tour operator or professional?
b2b.p: We act as your DMC in Al-Andalus. We deliver the groups on the ground; you keep the relationship with the end client.
b2b.cp: Licensed wholesale-retail travel agency based in Córdoba. Native Arabic-Spanish bilingual team.
nos.title: An agency with roots, born in Córdoba
nos.p1: Vive al Ándalus is the brand of Bin Firnas Travel SL, a family-run agency with official licence CIAN-147996-3, based in Córdoba, in the very heart of Al-Andalus.
nos.p2: We work as two specialists under one licence: an inbound service for groups coming to discover Al-Andalus, and an outbound service for clients travelling abroad.
nos.p3: We're not a generic booking portal. We're a team that knows every hotel, every guide and every restaurant in the cities we offer. If there's someone worth knowing on the ground, that's us.
